facts.fact: President Chakwera launched the Malawi Business Registration System (MBRS) on 29 February 2024, which he said will streamline business registration; online registration is not stated.

A Malawi official's UNODC working-group presentation says companies must file beneficial ownership information with the Registrar of Companies through the Malawi Business Registration System under regulations in effect since December 2022, and update it within 30 days.
Minister of Justice Charles Mhango says the Malawi Business Registration System allows businesses to register and maintain records online, and the registry estimates 20,000 companies register a year.
